At temperature 0.25, **DPO reaches a 0.31 win rate (31%) and PPO reaches 0.23 (23%)** against the ground-truth CNN/DailyMail summaries.

- **Source:** Table 1, "GPT-4 win rates vs. ground truth summaries for out-of-distribution CNN/DailyMail input articles," in Section 6.3 ("Generalization to a new input distribution").
- **Setup:** The DPO and PPO policies were trained on Reddit TL;DR and then tested on news articles from the CNN/DailyMail test split. They used the best sampling temperatures from TL;DR, which were 0 and 0.25. GPT-4 judged with the same "GPT-4 (C)" prompt used for TL;DR, with "forum post" changed to "news article" (Section 6.3).
- **Temperature 0:** DPO scores 0.36 and PPO scores 0.26 (Table 1).

The paper concludes that "DPO continues to outperform the PPO policy by a significant margin" on this new distribution (Section 6.3).

**Page numbers:** The document you provided is an HTML version of the paper with no page numbers, so I've cited the section and table instead.
